_comment: Voice casting for The Iron Wake. Maps speaker names (as passed to _say_as / dialogue_box.show_dialogue) to ElevenLabs premade voice IDs. Premade voices work with a TTS-only key (no voices_read permission needed). Edit voice_ids to recast. This file contains NO secrets and is safe to commit.
_speaker_settings_comment: Optional per-speaker overrides merged over voice_settings. ROWAN = Rowan's spoken dialogue (expressive base, no override). ROWAN_VO = the SAME voice as ROWAN but his narration/voiceover style (used by _say lines): steadier and less theatrical. Tuned via blind A/B review (2026-07-06): PINDLE flat/deadpan (style 0.0); TIBBIT expressive. Lower stability = more emotional variation, higher style = more expressive delivery.

_casting_notes.ROWAN: Antoni — versatile mid male, dry sarcasm (protagonist)
_casting_notes.ROWAN_VO: Antoni (same voice as ROWAN) — Rowan's narration/voiceover style: steadier, less theatrical than his spoken dialogue
_casting_notes.TIBBIT: Josh — brighter young male, enthusiastic tinkerer
_casting_notes.PINDLE: Adam — deep authoritative male, pompous bureaucrat
_casting_notes.CALIGO: Charlie — smooth accented, the velvet-voiced rival
